title: Cardholder Loyalty Lowering of the Northgate Optical Lab Retention
content:
Northgate Optical lowers the lab retention percentage on an in-lab cancellation for long-standing members who hold an active Northgate credit card. The two conditions are read from the Northgate Memberships record of the membership on the job and from the Northgate Credit Cards account linked to that membership.

**Bulletin.** Where the membership on the job has been held for at least 60 whole months and a Northgate credit card account linked to that membership is active, the lab retention percentage is lowered by 5 percentage points as a retention loyalty lowering; where it has been held for at least 24 but fewer than 60 whole months and such a card account is active, it is lowered by 2 points. Otherwise there is no retention loyalty lowering.

**Definitions.** The membership on the job is the membership presented on the eyewear job. Its months held are whole months from its opened date to the day the cancellation is worked out. A linked card account is a Northgate credit card account whose linked membership is that membership; it qualifies only while its status is active.

## Combinations

| Whole months held | Active linked Northgate credit card account | Retention loyalty lowering |
|---|---|---|
| 60 or more | yes | 5 percentage points |
| 60 or more | no | none |
| 24 to 59 | yes | 2 percentage points |
| 24 to 59 | no | none |
| fewer than 24 | either | none |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical members)

- Held 72 whole months, linked Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Plus account active: 5 points.
- Held 30 whole months, linked card account closed: none.
- Held exactly 24 whole months, linked Northgate Store Card active: 2 points.
